meta.envelope_note: Every operation returns ApiResponse<T>{isSuccess,message,data,errors}; envelope fields are CONTRACT_REQUIRED globally and omitted from per-endpoint field_flags.
meta.field_flag_scope: Fields of every payload model transitively reachable from the 200-response schema, named Model.field. Wrapper/envelope and paged-result shells are excluded. Statuses come from data/endpoint-consumers-frontend.json with author-verified upgrades (see upgraded evidence strings).
meta.field_flag_totals_note: field_flag totals count Model.field once per endpoint that returns the model, so shared models are counted repeatedly. Unique field counts across the 143 analyzed payload models are 460 USED / 54 UNUSED_CANDIDATE / 157 UNKNOWN_CONSUMER (data/endpoint-consumers-frontend.json models.totals), of which this author upgraded 10 flags to EXPENSIVE_UNUSED_CANDIDATE, 4 to EXPENSIVE_USED, 1 UNKNOWN-evidence USED (OwnerReconciliationStatus.candidates) confirmed USED, and 1 false USED (AccessAuditEventItem.metadata) reclassified as EXPENSIVE_UNUSED_CANDIDATE after re-verification.

Frontend deliberately requests pageSize=1000 (words models constants) and renders via cdk-virtual-scroll with a per-query session cache — the large page is a design choice, not accidental over-fetch. All fields are consumed. The dominant payload cost is the default System.Text.Json non-ASCII escaping (\uXXXX, 6 bytes per Arabic char; no AddJsonOptions anywhere in Backend/api) with no response-compression middleware — an encoder/compression finding, not a field-removal finding.
